name: organizations
description: Organizations is a web service that enables you to consolidate your multiple Amazon Web Services accounts into an organization and centrally manage your accounts and their resources.

subcommands.name: accept-handshake
subcommands.description: Accepts a handshake by sending an ACCEPTED response to the sender.

subcommands.name: attach-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches a policy to a root, an organizational unit (OU), or an individual account.

subcommands.name: cancel-handshake
subcommands.description: Cancels a Handshake.

subcommands.name: close-account
subcommands.description: Closes an Amazon Web Services member account within an organization.

subcommands.name: create-account
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Web Services account that is automatically a member of the organization whose credentials made the request.

subcommands.name: create-gov-cloud-account
subcommands.description: This action is available if all of the following are true: You're authorized to create accounts in the Amazon Web Services GovCloud (US) Region.

subcommands.name: create-organization
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Web Services organization.

subcommands.name: create-organizational-unit
subcommands.description: Creates an organizational unit (OU) within a root or parent OU.

subcommands.name: create-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a policy of a specified type that you can attach to a root, an organizational unit (OU), or an individual Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: decline-handshake
subcommands.description: Declines a Handshake.

subcommands.name: delete-organization
subcommands.description: Deletes the organization.

subcommands.name: delete-organizational-unit
subcommands.description: Deletes an organizational unit (OU) from a root or another OU.

subcommands.name: delete-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified policy from your organization.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the resource policy from your organization.

subcommands.name: deregister-delegated-administrator
subcommands.description: Removes the specified member Amazon Web Services account as a delegated administrator for the specified Amazon Web Services service.

subcommands.name: describe-account
subcommands.description: Retrieves Organizations-related information about the specified account.

subcommands.name: describe-create-account-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current status of an asynchronous request to create an account.

subcommands.name: describe-effective-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the contents of the effective policy for specified policy type and account.

subcommands.name: describe-handshake
subcommands.description: Returns details for a handshake.

subcommands.name: describe-organization
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the organization that the user's account belongs to.

subcommands.name: describe-organizational-unit
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about an organizational unit (OU).

subcommands.name: describe-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a policy.

subcommands.name: describe-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a resource policy.

subcommands.name: describe-responsibility-transfer
subcommands.description: Returns details for a transfer.

subcommands.name: detach-policy
subcommands.description: Detaches a policy from a target root, organizational unit (OU), or account.

subcommands.name: disable-aws-service-access
subcommands.description: Disables the integration of an Amazon Web Services service (the service that is specified by ServicePrincipal) with Organizations.

subcommands.name: disable-policy-type
subcommands.description: Disables an organizational policy type in a root.

subcommands.name: enable-all-features
subcommands.description: Enables all features in an organization.

subcommands.name: enable-aws-service-access
subcommands.description: Provides an Amazon Web Services service (the service that is specified by ServicePrincipal) with permissions to view the structure of an organization, create a service-linked role in all the accounts in the organization, and allow the service to perform operations on behalf of the organization and its accounts.

subcommands.name: enable-policy-type
subcommands.description: Enables a policy type in a root.

subcommands.name: invite-account-to-organization
subcommands.description: Sends an invitation to another account to join your organization as a member account.

subcommands.name: invite-organization-to-transfer-responsibility
subcommands.description: Sends an invitation to another organization's management account to designate your account with the specified responsibilities for their organization.

subcommands.name: leave-organization
subcommands.description: Removes a member account from its parent organization.

subcommands.name: list-accounts
subcommands.description: Lists all the accounts in the organization.

subcommands.name: list-accounts-for-parent
subcommands.description: Lists the accounts in an organization that are contained by the specified target root or organizational unit (OU).

subcommands.name: list-accounts-with-invalid-effective-policy
subcommands.description: Lists all the accounts in an organization that have invalid effective policies.

subcommands.name: list-aws-service-access-for-organization
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the Amazon Web Services services that you enabled to integrate with your organization.

subcommands.name: list-children
subcommands.description: Lists all of the organizational units (OUs) or accounts that are contained in the specified parent OU or root.

subcommands.name: list-create-account-status
subcommands.description: Lists the account creation requests that match the specified status that is currently being tracked for the organization.

subcommands.name: list-delegated-administrators
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon Web Services accounts that are designated as delegated administrators in this organization.

subcommands.name: list-delegated-services-for-account
subcommands.description: List the Amazon Web Services services for which the specified account is a delegated administrator.

subcommands.name: list-effective-policy-validation-errors
subcommands.description: Lists all the validation errors on an effective policy for a specified account and policy type.

subcommands.name: list-handshakes-for-account
subcommands.description: Lists the recent handshakes that you have received.

subcommands.name: list-handshakes-for-organization
subcommands.description: Lists the recent handshakes that you have sent.

subcommands.name: list-inbound-responsibility-transfers
subcommands.description: Lists transfers that allow you to manage the specified responsibilities for another organization.

subcommands.name: list-organizational-units-for-parent
subcommands.description: Lists the organizational units (OUs) in a parent organizational unit or root.

subcommands.name: list-outbound-responsibility-transfers
subcommands.description: Lists transfers that allow an account outside your organization to manage the specified responsibilities for your organization.

subcommands.name: list-parents
subcommands.description: Lists the root or organizational units (OUs) that serve as the immediate parent of the specified child OU or account.

subcommands.name: list-policies
subcommands.description: Retrieves the list of all policies in an organization of a specified type.

subcommands.name: list-policies-for-target
subcommands.description: Lists the policies that are directly attached to the specified target root, organizational unit (OU), or account.

subcommands.name: list-roots
subcommands.description: Lists the roots that are defined in the current organization.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists tags that are attached to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-targets-for-policy
subcommands.description: Lists all the roots, organizational units (OUs), and accounts that the specified policy is attached to.

subcommands.name: move-account
subcommands.description: Moves an account from its current source parent root or organizational unit (OU) to the specified destination parent root or OU.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a resource policy.

subcommands.name: register-delegated-administrator
subcommands.description: Enables the specified member account to administer the Organizations features of the specified Amazon Web Services service.

subcommands.name: remove-account-from-organization
subcommands.description: Removes the specified account from the organization.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: terminate-responsibility-transfer
subcommands.description: Ends a transfer.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes any tags with the specified keys from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-organizational-unit
subcommands.description: Renames the specified organizational unit (OU).

subcommands.name: update-policy
subcommands.description: Updates an existing policy with a new name, description, or content.

subcommands.name: update-responsibility-transfer
subcommands.description: Updates a transfer.
